verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to an AI agent is the product's core function. You type a goal like "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi" and press Start, and the in-app agent operates the phone across apps in the background, with Dynamic Island status. Saved tasks can be triggered from Siri, Shortcuts, widgets or Control Center, and runs are kept for step-by-step replay. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party README claims; the AI model is not bundled, so you must supply your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint and key.
